title: Drift Alternatives: 4 Car Scent Subscriptions Like It - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Drift alternative? Compare four car and home scent subscriptions by price, format, and scent choice, from smart diffusers to candles.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Car and home in one scent


### Magic Fragrance Box vs Drift


15% off


[Magic Fragrance Box Subscription](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/magic-candle-company) by Magic Fragrance Box®


From $27.95 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/magic-candle-company)


**Best for:** The Drift subscriber who also runs a diffuser at home and wants the car and the living room to smell the same.


Magic Fragrance Box comes from Magic Candle Company, which builds each month around one scent inspired by theme parks and resorts. Past boxes include Pineapple Whip, Polynesian, and Pirate Life. That scent arrives four ways: a candle, a 4 oz room spray, a wax melt, and a car air freshener.


#### What feels familiar


A new scent every month, a fresh freshener for the car, and free shipping.


#### What changes


You don’t choose the scent, and the car freshener hangs from the mirror on a string instead of clipping to the visor. Most of the box is for the house. If you only want the candle, the same seller’s[Magic Candle Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/magic-candle-box-subscription-wedwaycandlecompany) sends one a month for $15.95.


A candle for home


### Vellabox Glow Box vs Drift


[The Glow Box (8 oz Candle) | Monthly Subscription](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/the-ignis-box-vellabox3) by Vellabox


From $22.00 / box


Ships fast


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/the-ignis-box-vellabox3)


**Best for:** Someone who likes steering the scent and cares more about the bedroom than the car.


Vellabox works with a different candle maker each month and sends an 8 oz candle, with 50-plus hours of burn time, sized for a bedroom or another medium room. A small lifestyle gift comes with it. You set a scent profile when you order: Fresh, Floral, Sweet & Spice, Herbal, Citrus, Woodsy, or Surprise Me.


#### What feels familiar


You point it toward the scents you like, a new one arrives every month, and shipping is free. Like Drift, the fragrance is phthalate-free, and the candles use natural wax and cotton wicks.


#### What changes


Nothing here goes in the car, and a candle scents the room only while it burns, where Drift’s diffuser runs on its own. It also costs about twice as much as a Drift refill.


A smart diffuser


### Pura vs Drift


**Best for:** The driver who wants to control how strong the scent is, and may want the same system at home.


[Pura](https://pura.com/products/pura-car-pro) makes app-controlled diffusers for the car and for rooms at home. The cordless Pura Car costs $49.99, starts and stops on its own, and lets you set the strength in the Pura app. Car refills are Pura’s own scents, such as Teak & Leather and Red Rock & Amber. The full catalog runs past 300 fragrances, including Capri Blue and NEST New York for the home diffusers.


#### What feels familiar


A refill on a schedule, a scent you choose, free shipping on subscription orders, and pause or cancel anytime.


#### What changes


You pay $49.99 up front for the diffuser, and it needs USB-C power in the car. The home diffusers need Wi-Fi and the app. A car refill lasts up to four weeks at about an hour of diffusing a day.


Hanging fresheners you pick


### Ride FRSH vs Drift


**Best for:** The commuter who wants a strong new scent every week and doesn’t mind a freshener on the mirror.


[Ride FRSH](https://ridefrsh.com/products/rebundle-customized-subscription) , a Los Angeles brand, sends classic hanging car fresheners in scents like Midnight, New Car Scent, Cherry, and Pina Colada. Its FRSH 4 plan ships four that you choose every 30 days for $11.99, one for each week.


#### What feels familiar


You pick the scents, a box ships every month with tracking, and canceling is simple.


#### What changes


These hang from the mirror rather than sitting flat on the visor, and Ride FRSH suggests swapping every seven days, so none is meant to last a month. A smaller plan sends two for $5 a month, with shipping added at checkout.
